q: In the Fibonacci sequence, each number divided by the next is approximately: 斐波那契数列中，每个数除以后一个数约等于？
why: In 1,1,2,3,5,8,13... each number divided by the next is about 0.618 - the Golden Ratio.

q: Which retracement level do traders watch the most? 交易者最关注哪个回撤位？
why: 61.8% (together with 50%) is the most watched of the standard levels.

q: To draw a retracement in an uptrend, you drag the tool: 上涨趋势画回撤时，工具怎么拉？
opts: From the swing high to the swing low
From the current price to the 200 MA
From the 61.8% level to the 0% level
From the swing low to the swing high
why: In an uptrend, drag from the swing low to the swing high - 100% sits at the low and 0% at the high.

q: The golden pocket is the zone between: 黄金口袋是哪个区间？
why: The golden pocket is 0.618 to about 0.65 - where trend pullbacks most often reverse.

q: Fibonacci extensions like 127.2% and 161.8% are mainly used for: 斐波那契扩展位主要用来？
why: Extensions project where price may go after bouncing from the pocket - common take-profit targets.
